svg.title: Manunggul Jar: observation, interpretation, limit
svg.desc: Source-summary card, not an image of the original jar. The Manunggul Jar is from Palawan, associated with burial, and has two figures in a boat on its lid. An interpretation connects the imagery with a journey after death. It does not prove an afterlife or the beliefs of every community.

g.text: Observe: two figures in a boat on the lid
Interpret: imagery connected with a journey after death
Limit: not the beliefs of every community
Source summary, not an original artifact or supernatural proof
Compare with other sources before making a broader claim.
Teaching comparison: name the source, explain its meaning and state a limit.
